recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: clear autumn night over san francisco, twelve degrees and barely any wind
sunrise at six forty-five, sunset creeping earlier each evening
side projects quiet while product work holds the spotlight
agents spun up from a phone somewhere in the dark
shipping by sunrise on a day with twenty-eight degree highs
imagining twenty twenty-six from an empty commit week

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch falling task sparks before dawn breaks — each spark is a tiny ship-ready fix, burnout clouds drift in to steal your streak.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to move the collector left and right
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: fill the sunrise meter in 45 seconds by catching enough sparks
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: sparks fall faster and clouds multiply as the horizon brightens
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: warm gradient dawn, minimal glowing dots

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Three parallel agent lanes pulse at different tempos — tap when their heartbeats align to merge into one flow state and ship.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: land a ten-beat merge streak to trigger the ship animation
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: lanes desync and tempo accelerates each round
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe EKG traces on black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous surgical path from bug node to fix node through a shifting codebase maze without crossing legacy spaghetti.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to trace a single unbroken line
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: solve three micro-routes under sixty seconds total
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: walls migrate mid-draw and dead-end branches appear

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Autumn leaves tumble down three lanes — swipe each leaf into warm or cool shipping bins before fog blurs their hue.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe left or right to route each falling leaf
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: sort twenty leaves with a perfect-streak bonus at the end
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: leaves desaturate together and gusts swap lane positions
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor fog with muted orange and slate
